overview: The living-entity spawn packet carries the full state of a mob: type, position, rotations, velocity and the DataWatcher. Anticheats consume it on the send side to learn entity ids and types before any reach or hitbox measurement: Photon caches the entity type per id, TruthfulAC snapshots the spawn box into its compensation history, and Grim replicates the entity into the simulation used by reach and knockback checks. The type byte matters because hitbox dimensions depend on it, and a spawn without a tracker entry would leave every later entity packet orphaned.

checks.name: Living-entity id lookup (Photon)
checks.purpose: Cache the entity type for every spawned living entity so later modules can resolve an entity id to its type without Bukkit lookups.
checks.how_it_works: LivingEntityIdLookup registers a PacketSendEvent listener for SPAWN_LIVING_ENTITY, wraps the packet as WrapperPlayServerSpawnLivingEntity and stores (entityId, entityType) in a Guava cache capped at one million entries with a five-second default expiry. A delayed task pre-warms the cache from all loaded worlds at startup, and getEntityType serves id-to-type lookups for modules that need hitbox or behavior data.
checks.detects: Nothing: it is a utility cache. Modules such as the DamageIndicator and information hider consume it.
checks.variations: Grim replicates the full entity with metadata and rotations; Artemis resolves spawn ids through its EntityType registry; intave keeps EntityTypeDataRegistry with per-type hitbox sizes.

checks.name: Spawn compensation (TruthfulAC)
checks.purpose: Snapshot every spawned entity's position and hitbox into the compensation history so reach checks can backtrack against it.
checks.how_it_works: TruthfulPacketListener routes SPAWN_ENTITY (the 1.19+ living spawn) into CompensationTracker.handleSpawn, which stores a CompensatedEntity keyed by id with a ring of up to 30 tick snapshots and a base reach taken from the entity type (3.0 for players, 1.5 boats, 4.5 shulkers). handleEntitySnapshot re-stamps live Bukkit entities each tick, and getEntityData serves the backtracking reach check with up to 8 ticks of history.
checks.detects: Nothing directly; it is the compensation data layer behind the reach and hitbox checks.
checks.variations: Grim replicates spawns into compensatedEntities; Hydro inserts a TrackedEntity; Tecnio and Artemis seed their reach trackers from the same packet family.

checks.name: Entity replication (Grim)
checks.purpose: Replicate every spawned entity, including mobs, into the compensated entity map so reach, hitbox and velocity checks see the client's view.
checks.how_it_works: PacketEntityReplication.onPacketSend wraps SPAWN_LIVING_ENTITY as WrapperPlayServerSpawnLivingEntity and calls addEntity with entity id, uuid, type, position, rotations and the full metadata. The replicated entity then receives S14 relative moves and S18 teleports exactly like the client's copy, and DESTROY_ENTITIES removes it after the transaction that delivers the packet. Spawn velocity from the packet feeds knockback compensation without a separate S12.
checks.detects: Nothing directly: it is the replication layer. Reach and velocity checks consume the map, and the firework-boost path even setbacks players who destroy a boosting firework entity early.
checks.variations: Shard adds living spawns to compensatedEntities; Hydro tracks them in its entityMap; Kauri routes SPAWN_LIVING_ENTITY through its PacketHandler into the world tracker.
